selectionMethod: Bounded exact-species iNaturalist search, research-grade observations, per-photo CC0 licence and original short edge at least 600 pixels; at most two leads per candidate. Two transient empty-response failures were retried once and recovered. No taxonomy substitution or unlicensed image fallback.
limitations: No derivative downloaded, decoded, hashed, visually reviewed or uploaded in this remaining-forty search.
An empty bounded query is not proof that an appropriate photo does not exist.
Differently named taxa returned by the API are not automatically accepted as synonyms.
Research-grade observation and original dimensions do not establish botanical or medicinal clearance.
